definitions.short: properly, to be fat , i.e. (figuratively) silly
definitions.full: H3688. kasal [ כָסַל ] verb be or become stupid (Late Hebrew Aramaic in derivatives; Arabic be sluggish , so North Syriac in derivatives; original meaning possibly thick, plump, fat ; hence in good sense: כְּסָלִים loins , כִּסְלָה כֶּסֶל, confidence ; in bad sense: כְּסִילוּת כִּסְלָה, כֶּסֶל, stupidity, folly , כְּסִיל stupid fellow ) — Qal Imperfect יִכְסָ֑לוּ they become stupid Jer 10:8 (|| יִבְעֲרוּ they become brutish ).
